200.title: Emergency alert issued in Poland over Russian drones as locals 'hear explosions' and Nato jets scramble
200.summary: Panic has broken out in Nato ally Poland overnight amid claims jet-powered Russian drones shot over the border from Ukraine.
200.body: Panic has broken out in Nato ally Poland overnight amid claims jet-powered Russian drones shot over the border from Ukraine. The Polish Government issued an emergency alert just before 2am BST urging locals to follow orders in Lublin and Podkarpackie, the two regions that border Ukraine. Polish jets were scrambled in the early hours of Sunday morning amid the Russian threat (file photo) | REUTERS Multiple people said they had heard explosions in the early morning - though others claimed these may have been the sonic booms of jet fighters sent to respond to the threat.

400.body: Denmark is driving a pioneering project: the construction of energy islands that will collect electricity from offshore turbines, transmit it to the mainland and neighboring countries, and convert the surplus into green fuels using Power-to-X technologies. 500.title: Anthropic CEO calls for slower AI model development amid rising risks
500.summary: “Like many technologies before it, AI brings risks, and because it is such a powerful technology, these risks are serious. His three-step plan to manage AI risks calls for having embedded evaluators with employee-like access to verify safety practices, coordination among frontier AI firms to set safety standards, and greater coordination between governments.
500.body: “Like many technologies before it, AI brings risks, and because it is such a powerful technology, these risks are serious. His three-step plan to manage AI risks calls for having embedded evaluators with employee-like access to verify safety practices, coordination among frontier AI firms to set safety standards, and greater coordination between governments. The alarm comes a few days after Jacob Coxon, a scientist at Anthropic who resigned last week, said large language model (LLM) companies are not acting responsibly and are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with human lives. The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade.” Similarly, OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki wrote a paper last week saying that if reasoning language models continue to improve at the scale they are doing now, the systems will see a further capability jump in the next few years and increasingly drive their own development.

600.title: Poland’s Kazimierska storms to 1,500m gold in Budapest
600.summary: Poland’s Klaudia Kazimierska won the women’s 1,500m at the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest on Saturday, taking the $150,000 top prize. The 25-year-old moved into the lead with 200 meters remaining and held off Britain’s Georgia Hunter Bell to win in 3:57.55.
600.body: Poland’s Klaudia Kazimierska won the women’s 1,500m at the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest on Saturday, taking the $150,000 top prize. The 25-year-old moved into the lead with 200 meters remaining and held off Britain’s Georgia Hunter Bell to win in 3:57.55. Hunter Bell finished second in 3:57.72, with American Nikki Hiltz third. The Budapest event, which ends Sunday, is World Athletics’ new biennial season finale.
